title: Paired comparison of research administrative coordination with and without C.A.D.A.
objective: Estimate whether a documented C.A.D.A. work-management layer reduces administrative delay, rework and incomplete follow-up without changing the scientific methodology.

arms.difference: Use C.A.D.A. to capture, assign, set deadlines and track eligible administrative actions.
Use the pre-specified conventional task coordination process. Keep identical scientific quality safeguards and document activities without C.A.D.A. identifiers.

paired_units.unit: Documented administrative research-demand episode requiring a verifiable action and closure.
paired_units.inclusion: Episodes with explicit object, responsible party, next action, temporal expectation and evidence of completion.
paired_units.exclusion: Highly discretionary decisions, contested scientific judgment, unresolved political negotiation, arbitrary legal adjudication and inherently incomparable tasks.
paired_units.matching: Predefine pairs by work type, effort, complexity, input completeness and baseline stage before assignment.

allocation.design: Prospective matched alternating or randomized assignment where feasible; report deviations.
allocation.researcher_responsibility: Use same scientific protocol and human gate rules in both arms.
allocation.avoid_contamination: Record cross-arm spillover, learning, differences in tooling or staffing and other co-interventions.

measurement_sources: Task entry/receipt timestamps from the same independent event recorder in both arms
Versioned evidence of output and required correction requests
Independent reviewer assessment of scientific safeguards and claim/citation quality

primary_outcomes.name: time_to_first_action
primary_outcomes.definition: Elapsed hours from recorded capture to first verifiable action

primary_outcomes.name: time_to_closure
primary_outcomes.definition: Elapsed hours from accepted assignment to documented closure

primary_outcomes.name: administrative_rework
primary_outcomes.definition: Number of documented avoidable reopen/rework cycles per episode

primary_outcomes.name: unresolved_deadlines
primary_outcomes.definition: Share of due tasks lacking verifiable completion at cutoff
primary_outcomes.source: original agreed due dates and outcomes

scientific_safety_outcomes.name: protocol_compliance
scientific_safety_outcomes.assessment: Independent audit of identical research protocol and human gates
scientific_safety_outcomes.interpretation: Safety check, not an effect of C.A.D.A. itself

scientific_safety_outcomes.name: claim_support_errors
scientific_safety_outcomes.assessment: Independent blinded human review against source material
scientific_safety_outcomes.interpretation: Not inferred from task completion or Trace_ID counts

scientific_safety_outcomes.name: screening_error_or_disagreement
scientific_safety_outcomes.assessment: Independent document-level review of actual eligibility choices

analysis_plan.estimand: Within-pair difference in operational outcomes; specify baseline covariates and missingness.
analysis_plan.missing_data: Show unmatched, censored or inaccessible events; never fill missing with invented values.
analysis_plan.uncertainty: Report descriptive effect distributions and appropriate interval/uncertainty only if supported by adequate real data.
analysis_plan.quality_controls: Freeze outcome definitions, code version and eligibility before first comparison.
analysis_plan.public_claim_limit: No effectiveness statement unless real pairs, baseline comparability and uncertainty are documented.

threats_to_validity: Selection of easier tasks into an arm
Extra tooling and reminders accidentally given to CADA_ON
Researcher awareness and nonblinded task handling
Missing event receipts and undocumented follow-up
Changes in scientific protocol between comparison arms
note: Prepared protocol only. No interventions assigned, records collected, sample analyzed, efficacy proven or expert ratings obtained.
